title: Do physical and biogeochemical provinces coincide
query: Partitions of the ocean into provinces drawn from physical fields and from biogeochemical fields need not coincide. Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness and CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll, nitrate and oxygen for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), partition the region objectively once from the physical fields and once from the biogeochemical fields, quantify where and in which seasons the two partitions differ, and determine how much of the difference comes from the ocean, how much from the method, and how much from the two products' different grids and model systems.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
